title: Stock Held in Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) and the Seller Performance Standing Listing Expiry Period
content:
**Offset.** The stock-hold offset adds the no-disposal offset of 2 whole calendar months to the listing expiry period for a seller whose Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) enrollment still holds units on hand and billed no disposal removal fee in the last six whole calendar months, the disposal offset of 1 whole calendar month for a seller whose enrollment holds units on hand and billed a disposal removal fee in that period, and nothing for a seller whose enrollment holds no units or who has no enrollment.

The offset lengthens the period after which listing policy and restricted product violations expire on a Seller Performance Standing record, for both listing types alike.

## The records read

- **Units on hand** — the units the seller's Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) enrollment currently holds.
- **Disposal removal fees** — removal fee entries on that enrollment with the removal type disposal. A fee lies in the last six whole calendar months when fewer than six whole months have passed from its billing date to the handling date, counted by calendar date.

## Combinations

| Enrollment | Units on hand | Disposal removal fee billed in the last six whole calendar months | Months added |
|---|---|---|---|
| present | more than zero | none | 2 |
| present | more than zero | one or more | 1 |
| present | zero | either | none |
| none | — | — | none |

A return-to-seller removal fee is not a disposal removal fee and does not change the offset.

## Hypothetical cases

- An enrollment holds 40 units and its last disposal removal fee was billed seven whole months ago: no disposal fee lies in the period, so 2 months are added.
- The same enrollment with a disposal fee billed two months ago: 1 month is added.
- An enrollment that holds no units, whatever fees it billed: nothing is added.
